name: margin-companion
description: Send code from VS Code into your Notival notebook, and jump back to the exact lines from your notes.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Notival
walkthroughs.description: Send code to your notebook and come back to it from your notes.

steps.title: What this does
steps.description: Notival is a notebook app for the Mac. This extension is the bridge between it and VS Code: you select code here, it lands in a note there, and the note remembers exactly where it came from.

steps.title: Send a selection to Notival
steps.description:
Select a few lines of code in any file, then run the command (or right-click and choose it).
[Send selection to Notival](command:margin.capture)

steps.title: Come back to the lines
steps.description: In Notival, a captured block has a link back to the source. Clicking it opens this file here with the lines highlighted. A note you write in Notival can also appear here as a comment on those lines, without touching your file.
